Welcome to the Grafana Cloud learning path that shows you how to turn on auto-apply for a segment, choose a mode, and use the pages where you can enable it.

Auto-apply applies recommendations for that segment without a manual review each analysis cycle. A recommendation is a suggested aggregation that combines time series into fewer series. A time series is one metric name plus its labels. A segment is a group of metrics. The Default segment holds metrics that are not assigned to a named segment.

## Here's what to expect

When you complete this path, you'll be able to:

- Turn auto-apply on for the Default segment from Overview if you are not using segmentation yet, and choose coverage-first or cost-first
- Turn it on for multiple segments from Overview, with one mode for the selection
- Turn it on for a single segment on Segments, and choose the same mode there
- Turn it on after applying all recommendations on Metrics, and choose the same mode in that prompt

## Before you begin

Before you turn auto-apply on, make sure that:

- You have already applied recommendations yourself.
- Exemptions are in place for metrics you cannot afford to lose. An exemption keeps a metric out of recommendations. Refer to [Create exemptions](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/adaptive-telemetry/adaptive-metrics/create-exemptions/).
- You have the Admin role. That is the permission to turn auto-apply on, not a job title.
- You have a segment, usually Default. This path does not create a segment. Refer to [Configure segmentation](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/adaptive-telemetry/adaptive-metrics/additional-configuration/adaptive-metrics-rule-segmentation/).
